name: Alarm Suppression
summary: Adversaries may target protection function alarms to prevent them from notifying operators of critical conditions. Alarm messages may be a part of an overall reporting system and of particular interest for adversaries. Disruption of the alarm system does not imply the disruption of the reporting system as a whole. A Secura presentation on targeting OT notes a dual fold goal for adversaries attempting alarm suppression: prevent outgoing alarms…

analytics.name: Analytic 1861
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring of the alarm and process historian layer identifies an alarm status transitioning to suppressed, shelved, disabled, or acknowledged without a corresponding operator action recorded within a grace period, correlated with Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol write traffic to alarm configuration or threshold registers arriving in the same window from a source not in the approved engineering list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where…

analytics.name: Analytic 2107
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a write to alarm configuration files on a Linux-based Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)/alarm server by a User Identifier (UID) that is not the alarm management service, or the alarm management service process receiving Application Programming Interface (API) calls that suppress alarm classes without a corresponding operator session. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating…

analytics.name: Analytic 2108
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a write to alarm configuration files or database tables on an Human-Machine Interface (HMI)/alarm server by a process other than the recognized alarm management application, or an alarm-class-disable Application Programming Interface (API) call logged without a corresponding operator session ID in the HMI audit trail. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or…

analytics.name: Analytic 2188
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a network-device ACL, filter, or rate-limit policy change that suppresses or blocks ICS alarm-notification traffic outside the approved network-change baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
